result.rationale: Localized poison ivy contact dermatitis on forearms without systemic symptoms, facial/genital involvement, or breathing difficulty; manageable with OTC hydrocortisone, calamine, oral antihistamines, cool compresses, and avoiding scratching. Advise seeking care if rash spreads widely, involves face/eyes/genitals, shows signs of infection, or fails to improve in 1-2 weeks.
